import requests, numpy as np, json, itertools

varA=[3,4,5,7,12,22,34,41,57,98,156,179,204,306]
ifaceA=[34,87,109,110,111,112,113,114,115,117,120,121,124,153,154,165,166,168,169,171,172,175,193,194,195,

varB=[5,6,26,34,38,44,47,49,50,71,107,158,164,167,172,176,177,180,181,184,185,194,197,198,258,311,326,374,380,389,398,405,409]
ifaceB=[133,134,135,136,138,139,140,153,170,207,208,211,238,240,241,243,244,261,270,272,274,283,284,285,286,287,
        289,290,292,293,294,296,297,302,305,338,341,367,369,371,393,394]
bbB=[17,18,21,35,37,38,39,40,89,93,96,97,112,113,249,250,251,265,266,267,268,316]
LA,LB=309,409
Da=np.array([[0,0.0421,0.0227],[0.0421,0,0.0291],[0.0227,0.0291,0]])
Db=np.array([[0,0.0611,0.0463],[0.0611,0,0.0709],[0.0463,0.0709,0]])
ka=["a1 TVAG_318670","a2 TVAG_047890","a3 TVAG_165340"]; kb=["b1 TVAG_183500","b2 TVAG_259190","b3 TVAG_144730"]

def enr(var,iface,L):
    k=len(set(var)&set(iface));n=len(var);K=len(iface)
    return k,n,K,n*K/L,stats.hypergeom.sf(k-1,L,K,n),stats.hypergeom.cdf(k,L,K,n)
eA=enr(varA,ifaceA,LA); eB=enr(varB,ifaceB,LB); eBB=enr(varB,bbB,LB)
print("alpha  k,n,K,exp,p_enr,p_dep =",eA)
print("beta   k,n,K,exp,p_enr,p_dep =",eB)
print("betaBB k,n,K,exp,p_enr,p_dep =",eBB)

iu=np.triu_indices(3,1)
perms=list(itertools.permutations(range(3)))
rs=[np.corrcoef(Da[iu],Db[np.ix_(p,p)][iu])[0,1] for p in perms]
lbl=[" ".join(f"a{i+1}-b{p[i]+1}" for i in range(3)) for p in perms]
order=np.argsort(rs)[::-1]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,9.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.1,1.0,1.0],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.28)

# --- A: position maps ---
for row,(L,var,iface,extra,title,ex_lab) in enumerate([
    (LA,varA,ifaceA,None,"Alpha subunits (3 paralogs, 309 aa)",None),
    (LB,varB,ifaceB,bbB,"Beta subunits (3 paralogs, 409 aa)","beta-beta tetramer surface (E. coli)")]):
    ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,row])
    ax.hlines(1,1,L,color="0.85",lw=9)
    ax.vlines(iface,0.955,1.045,color="#3b76af",lw=1.6,label="alpha-beta interface (E. coli 1CQI, 4.5 A)")
    if extra is not None: ax.vlines(extra,0.90,0.95,color="#6aa84f",lw=1.6,label=ex_lab)
    ax.vlines(var,1.06,1.13,color="#c0392b",lw=1.8,label="position differing among the 3 paralogs")
    hit=sorted(set(var)&set(iface))
    if hit: ax.plot(hit,[1.0]*len(hit),marker="v",ls="none",ms=7,color="black",label="variable AND interfacial")
    ax.set_ylim(0.85,1.22); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(0,L+5)
    ax.set_xlabel("residue (T. vaginalis precursor numbering)"); ax.set_title(title,fontsize=10.5)
    ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="upper center",ncol=2,frameon=False,bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,-0.33))
    for s in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- B: observed vs expected ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
labels=["alpha var.\nat ab-interface","beta var.\nat ab-interface","beta var.\nat bb-surface"]
obs=[eA[0],eB[0],eBB[0]]; exp=[eA[3],eB[3],eBB[3]]
x=np.arange(3); ax.bar(x-0.19,exp,0.36,color="0.75",label="expected if random")
ax.bar(x+0.19,obs,0.36,color="#c0392b",label="observed")
for i,(o,e,p) in enumerate(zip(obs,exp,[eA[4],eB[4],eBB[4]])):
    ax.text(i,max(o,e)+0.18,f"P(enriched)={p:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel("number of positions")
ax.set_title("Paralog differences are not concentrated at the subunit interface",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); ax.set_ylim(0,5)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- C: Mantel floor ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
ax.barh(range(6),[rs[i] for i in order],color=["#3b76af" if rs[i]>0 else "0.7" for i in order])
ax.set_yticks(range(6)); ax.set_yticklabels([lbl[i] for i in order],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("Pearson r between alpha and beta p-distance matrices")
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
ax.set_title("All 6 pairings scored; exhaustive permutation p floor = 1/6 = 0.167",fontsize=10)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# --- D: residue table at the one variable interfacial position + Gln20beta column ---
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,:]); ax.axis("off")
rows=[["alpha pos 34 (only variable interface site)","Phe","Tyr","Phe","conservative aromatic; 1 of 52 interface positions"],
      ["alpha phosphohistidine His262 (interface)","His","His","His","invariant"],
      ["beta: all 42 alpha-beta interface positions","identical","identical","identical","0 of 33 substitutions fall here (P depleted = 0.024)"],
      ["beta col. = Blastocystis Gln20b (ATP determinant)","Gly","Gly","Gly","Gly in no characterised enzyme; E. coli (ATP) has Pro"],
      ["beta: E. coli beta-beta surface (22 pos.)","1 differs (Thr/Ser)","","","no paralog-specific oligomerisation surface"]]
tb=ax.table(cellText=rows,colLabels=["feature","alpha1 / beta1","alpha2 / beta2","alpha3 / beta3","note"],
            loc="center",cellLoc="left",colWidths=[0.28,0.13,0.13,0.13,0.33])
tb.auto_set_font_size(False); tb.set_fontsize(8); tb.scale(1,1.5)
for (r,c),cell in tb.get_celld().items():
    cell.set_linewidth(0.4)
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#e8eef5"); cell.set_text_props(weight="bold")
fig.suptitle("Trichomonas vaginalis succinyl-CoA synthetase: the three alpha and three beta paralogs carry no interface pairing signal",
             fontsize=12.5,y=0.985)
plt.show()
